name: Bloodbath
storyline:
As an operator, you must guide an android through an abandoned mansion in search of the object responsible for the paranormal activities in the location. As you explore, solve puzzles and investigate the dark past that runs in the blood of the Bailey family.

Through a computer, your task will be to write clear and direct commands so that the android understands and executes the actions needed to complete the mission.

Your mission is to find the paranormal object hidden in the Bailey Mansion.

Since the massacre that resulted in the deaths and disappearances of members of the family, the property has remained abandoned for 15 years. However, the place has now been revived by paranormal forces.
summary: Bloodbath is a suspense and investigation game with elements of horror, in which you take on the role of an operator responsible for controlling an android.
